scope: Pinned synchronous TP1 DFlash V2 response-end cache

requirements.contract: Only processed, visible positions are reusable; no bonus token or rejected suffix is committed.
Reuse requires an unchanged token prefix and cache namespace.
Source, destination and shared prefix remain owned until their last reader/copy completes.
Canonical convolution and recurrent state are exact copies of the accepted state, without arithmetic changes or writes to other blocks.
requirements.native: qualify_response_end.py --mode warm, handover, eviction, restore; qualify_response_end_state.py (test-only byte oracle; cold-prefill disagreement remains explicit)

requirements.contract: A replacement head and its exact endpoint are published together only after all dependencies verify; failed writes retain the previous head.
An extending prompt reuses the complete processed endpoint instead of replaying full blocks.

limits: Finite tests and source analysis, not proof of arbitrary inputs, numerical reference correctness or all interleavings. Unsupported cases must use the safe older prefix.
